name: E. Markov
description: A figure who brokered the creation of vampires and with his sons trapped and drained the angel Marycz.

timeline.summary: The journal reveals vampires were created by humans: Markov and the demon Shilgengar used an angel's blood, after trapping and draining Marycz.
